field.label: Area rules (JSON)
field.comment: Initial administrator configuration. Array of objects: country (EG/AE/SA/US), city_id (0 for country), locality_id (0 for city), sku (* for all), status (green/red/blacklist). Blacklist wins, then red. Green confirms coverage only. No rules means coverage is unconfigured. Example: [{"country":"EG","city_id":123,"locality_id":0,"sku":"*","status":"blacklist"}]
